npm.derivation: Builtin-only static literal resolution plus bounded reached-package JS/CJS/MJS/JSON envelopes. Root command selection admits install only. Excludes unrelated root commands, dependency CLI bins, tests, docs, examples, benchmarks, maps and build configs unless a resolved literal explicitly requires them. No tool modules were imported.

npm.qualification: Conservative finite static-admission set, NOT a proven dynamically minimal closure. Text scanning includes comment/string false positives. Actual unknown module paths MUST refuse without expansion/retry. npm/config dynamic package.json and root cliEntry/install selection are explicitly seeded; unused CLI/completion branches are not approved.
